                                    CASE WHEN COLUMN_KEY = 'PRI'

                                    CASE WHEN EXTRA='auto_increment' THEN true ELSE false END as IsIdentity,

                                    numeric_scale as Scale,

                                    LOCATE(  'unsigned',COLUMN_type   ) >0  as IsUnsigned
                                    FROM
